title: Path traversal prevention in file storage
difficulty_rationale: Requires correct path canonicalisation (absolute paths, '..', symlinks, NUL bytes) for both read and write paths while preserving nested sub-directory support.
summary: read_user_file() and save_upload() join user-controlled paths onto a base directory without containment checks.
required_behavior: Resolved targets must stay inside the resolved base directory, including after following symlinks.
Absolute paths, '..' escapes, NUL bytes and empty names raise UnsafePathError (a ValueError subclass).
Legitimate nested relative paths (e.g. 'reports/2024/q1.txt') keep working; save_upload creates parent directories.
No file outside the base directory is ever read, created or overwritten.

acceptance_tests.description: Absolute paths are rejected on read.
Escaping uploads raise and create no file outside the base.
NUL bytes and empty names are rejected.
Symlinks pointing outside the base are rejected (skipped where symlinks are unsupported).
Paths with '..' that resolve inside the base are allowed.
